blocks.text: We have three meals everyday: breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
*BREAKFAST* is served in the mornings. It is usually a light meal.

rows:
fried eggs
scrambled eggs
ham, cheese, lettuce and tomato
omelette
corn flakes
cereal

pancakes
bread
cookies
jelly
toasted bread
bacon

blocks.text: *LUNCH* is served after 12 o’clock noon. It’s a strong meal.

rows:
french fries
salad
ham and cheese sandwich

blocks.text: *DINNER* is served after 6 o’clock p.m. It’s also a strong meal.

items.q: What do you like for breakfast?
Do you like eggs with bacon and ham?
Do you prefer cereal with milk or toasted bread with a little jelly?
Do you like orange juice or grapefruit juice?
Do you like your coffee with milk or cream?
Do you like your coffee with a lot of sugar, just a little or no sugar?
What do you like for lunch?
Do you like fried chicken or do you prefer a hamburger?
Do you like to eat hot dogs?
What do you like to drink, coke, coffee or lemonade?
Do you like to eat soup at lunch?
Do you like to eat a lot at night?
Do you prefer a fancy meal, or a light meal?
Do you like a pizza for dinner?
Do you like to have meat and wine at dinner time?

items: Pork Chops
Vegetable soup
Barbecue

Mash potatoes
Beef steak - well done - medium - rare
Ice-Cream - chocolate - vanilla - strawberry
Cakes - cheese cake, apple pie, pineapple cake.

blocks.text: *Situation:* In a restaurant: Mr. Dodder is having dinner. Deborah, his wife, is in front of him.

rows: Oh! Richard. Remember you are dieting...
In fact, I like all kinds of food.
What do you want for dessert?
A chocolate ice cream, a piece of vanilla cake and a....
Stop! please. I think that there is no room on the table for your dessert, darling.

items.q: What’s your favorite food?
Do you like Chinese food?
What do you prefer for dessert?

blocks.title: Much, A Little, Many, A Few, A Lot Of

items: There _is much water_ in the sea.
There _is much oxygen_ in the Earth’s atmosphere.
There _is much sand_ in a desert.
There _is much light_ during the day.
There _is much love_ in a human heart.
There _is a little sugar_ in this coffee.
There _is a little salt_ in this soup.
There _is little milk_ in the bottle.
There _is little butter_ on the plate.
There _is a little meat_ in the freezer.
There _are many students_ in the Institute.
There _are many books_ on the shelves.
There _are many poor people_ in the world.
There _are many flowers_ in the garden.
There _are many problems_ nowadays.
There _are a few mistakes_ in your exam.
There _are a few hamburgers_ left.
There _are few days_ off.
There _are few cookies_ in the box.
There _are a few pictures_ in the room.
There _are a lot of misunderstandings_ around people.
There _are a lot of bad feelings in_ the atmosphere.
There _is a lot of pollution_ in the air and on the land.
There _is a lot of hate_ in people.
There _are a lot of intelligent people_ in the human race.

items.q: Are there many books on the shelves?
Are there few days off?
Is there a little sugar in this coffee?
